constraints.definition: CHECK (resource_type = 'skills'::text AND skill_id::text = resource_id OR resource_type = 'courses'::text AND course_id::text = resource_id OR resource_type = 'books'::text AND isbn::text = resource_id OR resource_type = 'certifications'::text AND certification_id::text = resource_id OR resource_type = 'jobs'::text AND job_id::text = resource_id OR resource_type = 'majors'::text AND major_id::text = resource_id)

constraints.name: vector_type_matches_source
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE resource_type
    WHEN 'skills'::text THEN skill_id IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'courses'::text THEN course_id IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'books'::text THEN isbn IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'certifications'::text THEN certification_id IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'jobs'::text THEN job_id IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'majors'::text THEN major_id IS NOT NULL
    ELSE false
END)
